title: Faster agent checks
summary: Feature requests finish sooner because the game's checks now take a fraction of the time.
notes: Run the game's unit tests at a fixed frame rate, cutting them from about three minutes to under half a minute.
Stop running every test when an agent checks a single test file.
Skip the harness's final check when the agent already passed it on the same files.
Skip the harness and release script self-tests on branches that don't touch them.
Reuse imported game assets from the last main build in CI.
